# Running pandoc as a web server

If you rename (or symlink) the pandoc executable to
`pandoc-server`, or if you call pandoc with `server` as the first
argument, it will start up a web server with a JSON API. This
server exposes most of the conversion functionality of pandoc. For
full documentation, see the [pandoc-server] man page.

If you rename (or symlink) the pandoc executable to
`pandoc-server.cgi`, it will function as a CGI program
exposing the same API as `pandoc-server`.

`pandoc-server` is designed to be maximally secure; it uses
Haskell's type system to provide strong guarantees that no I/O
will be performed on the server during pandoc conversions.

[pandoc-server]: https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/blob/master/doc/pandoc-server.md

# Running pandoc as a Lua interpreter

Calling the pandoc executable under the name `pandoc-lua` or with
`lua` as the first argument will make it function as a standalone
Lua interpreter. The behavior is mostly identical to that of the
[standalone `lua` executable][lua standalone], version 5.4.
All `pandoc.*` packages, as well as the packages `re` and `lpeg`,
are available via global variables. Furthermore, the globals
`PANDOC_VERSION`, `PANDOC_STATE`, and `PANDOC_API_VERSION` are
set at startup. For full documentation, see the [pandoc-lua] man page.

[lua standalone]: https://www.lua.org/manual/5.4/manual.html#7
[pandoc-lua]: https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/blob/master/doc/pandoc-lua.md

# A note on security

1. Although pandoc itself will not create or modify any files other
   than those you explicitly ask it create (with the exception
   of temporary files used in producing PDFs), a filter or custom
   writer could in principle do anything on your file system. Please
   audit filters and custom writers very carefully before using them.

2. Several input formats (including LaTeX, Org, RST, and Typst)
   support `include` directives that allow the contents of a file to be
   included in the output. An untrusted attacker could use these
   to view the contents of files on the file system. (Using the
   `--sandbox` option can protect against this threat.)

3. Several output formats (including RTF, FB2, HTML with
   `--self-contained`, EPUB, Docx, and ODT) will embed encoded
   or raw images into the output file.  An untrusted attacker
   could exploit this to view the contents of non-image files on the
   file system.  (Using the `--sandbox` option can protect
   against this threat, but will also prevent including images in
   these formats.)

4. In reading HTML files, pandoc will attempt to include the
   contents of `iframe` elements by fetching content from the
   local file or URL specified by `src`. If untrusted HTML is
   processed on a server, this has the potential to reveal anything
   readable by the process running the server. Using the `-f html+raw_html`
   will mitigate this threat by causing the whole `iframe`
   to be parsed as a raw HTML block. Using `--sandbox` will also
   protect against the threat.

def rst_block(block,ctx):
    t=block.get("t"); c=block.get("c")
    if t=="Para":
        if len(c)==1 and c[0].get("t")=="Math" and c[0]["c"][0]=="DisplayMath":
            return f".. math:: {c[0]['c'][1]}"
        if any(x.get("t")=="LineBreak" for x in c):
            # split by LineBreak
            segs=[]; cur=[]
            for x in c:
                if x.get("t")=="LineBreak": segs.append(cur); cur=[]
                else: cur.append(x)
            segs.append(cur)
            return "\n".join("| "+rst_inline(seg,ctx) for seg in segs)
        return rst_inline(c,ctx)
    if t=="Plain": return rst_inline(c,ctx)
    if t=="Header":
        level,attr,inls=c
        text=rst_inline(inls,ctx)
        chars={1:"=",2:"-",3:"~",4:"^",5:'"',6:"#"}
        ul=chars.get(level,"=")*len(text)
        return f"{text}\n{ul}"
    if t=="CodeBlock":
        attr,code=c
        lang=attr[1][0] if attr[1] else ""
        indented="\n".join("   "+l for l in code.split("\n"))
        if lang:
            return f".. code:: {lang}\n\n{indented}"
        return "::\n\n"+indented
    if t=="RawBlock": return c[1] if c[0]=="rst" else ""
    if t=="BlockQuote":
        inner="\n\n".join(rst_block(b,ctx) for b in c)
        return "\n".join("   "+l if l else "" for l in inner.split("\n"))
    if t=="BulletList":
        items=[]
        for item in c:
            txt="\n\n".join(rst_block(b,ctx) for b in item)
            lines=txt.split("\n")
            items.append("- "+lines[0]+"\n"+"\n".join("  "+l if l else "" for l in lines[1:]))
        return "\n".join(items)
    if t=="OrderedList":
        (start,style,delim),items_list=c
        items=[]
        for idx,item in enumerate(items_list):
            marker=format_list_marker(start+idx,style,delim)
            txt="\n\n".join(rst_block(b,ctx) for b in item)
            lines=txt.split("\n")
            items.append(f"{marker} "+lines[0])
            for l in lines[1:]: items[-1]+="\n"+" "*(len(marker)+1)+l
        return "\n".join(items)
    if t=="DefinitionList":
        parts=[]
        for term,defs in c:
            parts.append(rst_inline(term,ctx))
            for d in defs:
                txt=" ".join(rst_block(b,ctx) for b in d)
                parts.append("   "+txt)
        return "\n".join(parts)
    if t=="LineBlock": return "\n".join("| "+rst_inline(l,ctx) for l in c)
    if t=="HorizontalRule": return "------------"
    if t=="Div": return "\n\n".join(rst_block(b,ctx) for b in c[1])
    if t=="Figure":
        for b in c[2]:
            if b.get("t") in ("Plain","Para"):
                for inl in b["c"]:
                    if inl.get("t")=="Image":
                        return rst_inline([inl],ctx)
        return ""
    if t=="Table":
        return rst_table(block,ctx)
    return ""

        if first.get("type")=="ordered" and first.get("token","").isupper() and len(first.get("token",""))==1 and first.get("delim_char")=="." and not first.get("paren_open"):
            return None,0
        base_indent=first["indent"]
        is_bullet=first["type"]=="bullet"
        def signature(mm):
            if mm["type"]=="bullet": return ("bullet", mm.get("marker"))
            tok=mm.get("token","")
            if tok=="#": cat="default"
            elif tok.isdigit(): cat="decimal"
            elif tok.islower(): cat="lower"
            elif tok.isupper(): cat="upper"
            else: cat="other"
            return ("ordered", mm.get("delim_char") if not (mm.get("paren_open") and mm.get("paren_close")) else "TwoParens", cat, bool(mm.get("paren_open")), bool(mm.get("paren_close")))
        # delim normalization for signature: match_list_marker stores delim_char ")" or "." and paren flags; TwoParens case token style second function handles.
        def sig_of(mm):
            if mm["type"]=="bullet": return ("bullet", mm.get("marker"))
            # compute delim label
            if mm.get("delim_char")=="TwoParens": delim="TwoParens"
            elif mm.get("paren_open") and mm.get("paren_close"): delim="TwoParens"
            elif mm.get("delim_char")==")": delim="OneParen"
            elif mm.get("delim_char")==".": delim="Period"
            else: delim=mm.get("delim_char")
            tok=mm.get("token","")
            if tok=="#": cat="default"
            elif tok.isdigit(): cat="decimal"
            elif tok.islower(): cat="lower"
            elif tok.isupper(): cat="upper"
            else: cat="other"
            return ("ordered", delim, cat)
        first_sig=sig_of(first)
        items_raw=[]; cols=[]; markers=[]; loose=False
        j=i; current=None; current_col=2
        while j<len(lines):
            line=lines[j]
            if line.strip()=="":
                # lookahead
                k=j
                while k<len(lines) and lines[k].strip()=="": k+=1
                if k>=len(lines): break
                nxt=lines[k]
                mmk=self.match_list_marker(nxt)
                nxt_indent=len(nxt)-len(nxt.lstrip(' '))
                if mmk and nxt_indent==base_indent and sig_of(mmk)==first_sig:
                    loose=True

                    j=k; continue
                elif current is not None and (nxt.startswith("    ") or nxt.startswith("\t") or (nxt.startswith(" ") and nxt_indent>=current_col)):
                    loose=True
                    current.append("")
                    j+=1; continue
                else:

            mm=self.match_list_marker(line)
            cur_indent=len(line)-len(line.lstrip(' '))
            if mm and cur_indent==base_indent:
                if sig_of(mm)!=first_sig:
                    break
                markers.append(mm)
                current=[mm.get("content","")]
                items_raw.append(current)
                current_col=self.content_column(line); cols.append(current_col)
                j+=1; continue
            if current is None:
                break
            # indented continuation
            if line.startswith(" ") or line.startswith("\t"):
                current.append(line); j+=1; continue
            # lazy continuation: only if no blank just before (current last != "") and line is not a block starter
            if current and current[-1]!="":
                if re.match(r'^(#{1,6}\s|```|~~~|>)', line): break
                if mm: break
                # HTML block etc break?
                current.append(line); j+=1; continue
            break
        if not items_raw:
            return None,0
        # Determine ordered style/start from markers
        style="Decimal"; delim="Period"; start=1
        if not is_bullet:
            style,delim,start=self.list_style_delim(first)
            toks=[m.get("token","") for m in markers]
            if toks and all(t.isalpha() for t in toks):
                # roman detection
                def is_roman(t): return all(ch in "ivxlcdmIVXLCDM" for ch in t)
                if all(is_roman(t) for t in toks):
                    # sequence check: if first is i/I or tokens length>1 roman sequence or token is multi-char roman
                    if toks[0].lower()=="i" or len(toks[0])>1 or (len(toks)>1 and toks[1].lower() in ("ii","iii","iv","v")):
                        style="LowerRoman" if toks[0].islower() else "UpperRoman"; start=roman_to_int(toks[0])
                    elif toks[0].lower() in ("v","x","l","c"):
                        style="LowerRoman" if toks[0].islower() else "UpperRoman"; start=roman_to_int(toks[0])
                # else alpha already from first
                if style not in ("LowerRoman","UpperRoman"):
                    style="LowerAlpha" if toks[0].islower() else "UpperAlpha"; start=ord(toks[0].lower())-96 if len(toks[0])==1 else 1
            elif toks and toks[0].isdigit():
                style="Decimal"; start=int(toks[0])
            elif toks and toks[0]=="#":
                style="Default"; start=1
        # Build items
        items=[]
        for idx,raw in enumerate(items_raw):
            col=cols[idx] if idx<len(cols) else 2
            dedented=[]
            if raw: dedented.append(raw[0])
            for l in raw[1:]:
                if l=="": dedented.append(""); continue
                # strip up to col spaces
                cnt=0
                while cnt<col and cnt<len(l) and l[cnt]==" ": cnt+=1
                dedented.append(l[cnt:])
            while dedented and dedented[-1]=="": dedented.pop()
            if "" in dedented: loose=True
            bl=self.parse_blocks(dedented, in_list_item=True)
            if not loose:

                for b in bl:

            lst=B("BulletList", items)
        else:
            lst=B("OrderedList", [[start,style,delim], items])
        return lst, j-i

class TemplateParser:
    def __init__(self, text, context, partials):
        self.text=text; self.ctx=context; self.partials=partials; self.i=0; self.n=len(text)
    def render(self):
        out, terminator = self.render_until([])
        return out
    def render_until(self, terminators):
        # returns (output, terminator_found or None) ; leaves index after terminator directive if found
        out=[]
        while self.i<self.n:
            if self.text.startswith("$$", self.i):
                out.append("$"); self.i+=2; continue
            if self.text[self.i]=="$":
                # find closing $
                j=self.text.find("$", self.i+1)
                if j==-1:
                    out.append(self.text[self.i:]); self.i=self.n; break
                expr=self.text[self.i+1:j].strip()
                # comment $-- ... $ ? Pandoc template comment: $-- comment ? Actually sequences: $\n$-- ??? Template files have lines: $--\n$-- section numbering\n$--
                # When expr starts with --, it's comment extending to next $ (?) Our find closing $ gives expr="--" then following text until next $? Hmm template snippet:
                # $--\n$-- section numbering\n$--\n$if(...)$
                # So each $-- ... $ is a directive where content until next $ is comment? Our parsing: at first $, j finds next $ which is at start of next line's $--, expr="--\n" - comment, consume.
                if expr.startswith("--"):
                    self.i=j+1; continue
                if expr in terminators:
                    self.i=j+1; return "".join(out), expr
                # $else$ , $endif$, $endfor$, $sep$ are terminators handled by callers - if encountered unexpected, skip
                if expr=="else" or expr.startswith("endif") or expr=="endfor" or expr=="sep":
                    # return to caller with that
                    self.i=j+1; return "".join(out), expr
                if expr.startswith("if(") and expr.endswith(")"):
                    var=expr[3:-1].strip()
                    self.i=j+1
                    true_out, term=self.render_until(["else","endif"])
                    false_out=""
                    if term=="else":
                        false_out, term2=self.render_until(["endif"])
                    val=self.lookup(var)
                    out.append(true_out if truthy(val) else false_out)
                    continue
                if expr.startswith("for(") and expr.endswith(")"):
                    var=expr[4:-1].strip()
                    self.i=j+1
                    # Need capture raw body template segment until matching $endfor$ (handling nested for/if) to repeat.
                    body_start=self.i
                    body_template, sep_template, end_pos=self.capture_for_body()
                    self.i=end_pos
                    val=self.lookup(var)
                    items=[]
                    if isinstance(val,list): items=val
                    elif val is None or val=="" or val==False: items=[]
                    else: items=[val]
                    rendered_items=[]
                    for item in items:
                        sub_ctx=dict(self.ctx)
                        # $it$ and $var$ refer to item; also if item dict, its fields?
                        sub_ctx["it"]=item
                        sub_ctx[var]=item
                        if isinstance(item,dict):
                            for k,v in item.items(): sub_ctx[k]=v
                        # render body
                        rendered_items.append(template_render(body_template, sub_ctx, self.partials))
                    sep=""
                    if sep_template is not None:
                        sep=template_render(sep_template, self.ctx, self.partials)
                    out.append(sep.join(rendered_items))
                    continue
                if expr.endswith("()"):
                    partial_name=expr[:-2]
                    tmpl=self.partials.get(partial_name) or self.partials.get("templates/"+partial_name) or DATA.get("data_files",{}).get("templates/"+partial_name,{}).get("out") if 'DATA' in globals() else None
                    if tmpl:
                        out.append(template_render(tmpl, self.ctx, self.partials))
                    else:
                        # special styles.html etc already in data_files
                        out.append("")
                    continue
                # variable with modifiers /nowrap, /pairs etc, and subfields a.b.c
                var_expr=expr
                # strip /...
                if "/" in var_expr:
                    var_expr=var_expr.split("/")[0]
                val=self.lookup(var_expr)
                out.append(stringify_template_value(val))
                self.i=j+1; continue
            else:
                # plain char until next $
                j=self.text.find("$", self.i)
                if j==-1: j=self.n
                out.append(self.text[self.i:j]); self.i=j
        return "".join(out), None
    def capture_for_body(self):
        # starting at self.i, find matching $endfor$ counting nested for, also $sep$ at depth0
        depth=0; pos=self.i; sep_pos=None; sep_end=None
        while pos<self.n:
            if self.text.startswith("$$",pos): pos+=2; continue
            if self.text[pos]=="$":
                j=self.text.find("$",pos+1)
                if j==-1: break
                expr=self.text[pos+1:j].strip()
                if expr.startswith("for(") and expr.endswith(")"):
                    depth+=1
                elif expr=="endfor":
                    if depth==0:
                        body_end=pos
                        if sep_pos is not None:
                            body_template=self.text[self.i:sep_pos]
                            sep_template=self.text[sep_end:body_end]
                        else:
                            body_template=self.text[self.i:body_end]; sep_template=None
                        return body_template, sep_template, j+1

def od_content_lines(inlines,ctx):
    element_types={"Emph","Strong","Strikeout","Superscript","Subscript","SmallCaps","Underline","Code","Link","Image"}
    lines=[""]; 
    inls=list(inlines or [])
    for idx,n in enumerate(inls):
        t=n.get("t")
        if t=="Space":
            # skip if next is element (will be line break)
            if idx+1<len(inls) and inls[idx+1].get("t") in element_types:
                continue
            lines[-1]+=" "; continue
        if t in element_types:
            rendered=od_inline([n],ctx)
            if lines[-1]=="": lines[-1]=rendered
            else:
                lines[-1]=lines[-1].rstrip()
                lines.append(rendered)
        else:
            lines[-1]+=od_inline([n],ctx)
    return "\n".join(lines)

def od_block(block,ctx,indent=0, para_kind="body"):
    sp=" "*indent; t=block.get("t"); c=block.get("c")
    if t=="Header":
        level,attr,inls=c
        ctx._od_after_header=True
        inner=od_inline(inls,ctx)
        if attr[0]:
            return f'{sp}<text:h text:style-name="Heading_20_{level}" text:outline-level="{level}"><text:bookmark-start text:name="{xml_escape(attr[0])}" />{inner}<text:bookmark-end text:name="{xml_escape(attr[0])}" /></text:h>'
        return f'{sp}<text:h text:style-name="Heading_20_{level}" text:outline-level="{level}">{inner}</text:h>'
    if t in ("Para","Plain"):
        if getattr(ctx,"_od_after_header",False) and para_kind=="body":
            style="First_20_paragraph"; ctx._od_after_header=False
        else:
            style=od_para_style(ctx,para_kind)
            if para_kind=="body": ctx._od_after_header=False
        # multiline wrapping will be applied by writer-level wrap (exempted) - pandoc wraps at 72 in od: handled by main wrap? It was exempted, so keep one line; sample wraps due to flow in headings/para at certain points. We'll return one line.
        return f'{sp}<text:p text:style-name="{style}">{od_inline(c,ctx)}</text:p>'
    if t=="BulletList" or t=="OrderedList":
        items=c if t=="BulletList" else c[1]
        lnum=getattr(ctx,"_od_list_counter",0)+1; ctx._od_list_counter=lnum
        lines=[f'{sp}<text:list text:style-name="L{lnum}">']
        for item in items:
            lines.append(f"{sp}  <text:list-item>")
            for sub in item:
                if sub.get("t") in ("Para","Plain"):
                    lines.append(f'{sp}    <text:p text:style-name="{od_para_style(ctx,"list")}">{od_inline(sub["c"],ctx)}</text:p>')
                else: lines.append(od_block(sub,ctx,indent+4))
            lines.append(f"{sp}  </text:list-item>")
        lines.append(f"{sp}</text:list>"); return "\n".join(lines)
    if t=="BlockQuote":
        lines=[]
        for sub in c:
            if sub.get("t") in ("Para","Plain"):
                lines.append(f'{sp}<text:p text:style-name="{od_para_style(ctx,"quote")}">{od_inline(sub["c"],ctx)}</text:p>')
            else: lines.append(od_block(sub,ctx,indent))
        return "\n".join(lines)
    if t=="CodeBlock":
        code_lines=xml_escape_text(c[1]).replace("\n","<text:line-break/>")
        return f'{sp}<text:p text:style-name="{od_para_style(ctx,"code")}">{code_lines}</text:p>'
